name: 8-spells
note: The Herald's spell database, captured in 2004 (late SI / ToA): spell lines per class (line.php?c=..&line=.., which spell at which level) first, then each spell's page (spell.php?s=N&level=L). One save per distinct line and per spell id (its latest capture). About 2,950 pages, roughly 2.5 hours of requests: under the daily cap with the other jobs it takes two or three days and continues by itself each run.

targets.note: Seen in the map: 245 spell-line pages (line.php?c=<class>&line=<line>, also ?line=<line> alone).
Seen in the map: the spell database index (index.php, index.php?line=N).
Seen in the map: 2,707 spell pages (spell.php?s=<id>&level=<level>); one per spell id.
